teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Answered student questions during office hours on introductory programming topics, including lists, arrays, and loops.
Assisted introductory programming lab sessions and helped organise assignment materials and submission records.

projects.title: Library Catalogue
bullets: Documented how records are added, searched, and updated in a Java library catalogue course project.
Tested representative inputs and recorded expected outputs, added input checks, and handled invalid entries.

projects.title: Set Operation Explorer
bullets: Tested the Java set operation explorer against hand-worked cases and constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules.
Explained the connection between formal definitions and their implementation in the set operation explorer.
